what: Checks run on 2026-09-29 on the author's production deployment of this engine and server design, after the seeded-sampling fix and the client-disconnect cancellation were added.
important: These were produced by the author's development and production tooling, which is not included in this repository.
The production deployment uses the same engine and server design as this release under different internal names.

speed_after_seeded_fix.what: Lab harness, paired A/B in one process: the engine with the seeded-sampling fix vs the build that measured 15.0 tok/s on 2026-09-28. Greedy, 4 prompts x 512 tokens, alternating order, 1 warm-up round excluded.
speed_after_seeded_fix.note: No measurable speed change from the fix. Absolute rates that day were about 13 tok/s for both builds because of machine state (about 4 GB of swap in use); compare the paired gain, not the absolutes.

criterion_written_before_first_request: OLS slope over the last 15 scored requests <= 1.0 MB/request

identity: 8 cases x 3 read modes, greedy and seeded, equal to the stock mlx-lm reference in evidence/golden_stock_mlx_lm.json (0 mismatches).
